name: Handy Haversack
description: A leather backpack with two side pouches and a central pack that is always the right size.
body:
## What it does

Each side pouch holds 20 pounds and the central pack 80, 120 pounds in all, and the haversack weighs 5 pounds whatever is inside. Whatever you reach for is always on top.

## Careful

Pierced or torn, it is ruined and what it held is lost. Put inside another extradimensional space, it tears open a gate to the Astral Plane.
